title: Debra M Probable NDE 6933
content: I remember very vividly as though it happened yesterday. I actually went up and back from where I call 'home' three different times. I can recall being pulled or drawn to a very compelling bright light: spinning around very quickly. As I proceeded moving toward this light, I remember that there was some sort of wall, also spinning around me. I automatically had knowledge that whatever was in that spinning mass surrounding me was distant from God and life. It was not death but it was not good. It made me feel very sad. When I went into the light, I had no doubt that God was present. All the colors were much brighter; I felt a surge of energy. That energy was God giving me knowledge of where I was. Some he allowed me to be able to share and some things were very personal. I can't tell you what made me understand that it was God, I just knew. This happened to me three different times. I also remember that each time I crossed over into the spiritual world and came back; I possessed a different spirit, one of a boy in fact. The spirit that I possess now is one that has been alive forever. What happened to each spirit that I carried in each experience was left behind with God, including the one that I was born into the flesh. The one that lives in myself now was the last one God sent me back into the living world to finish out what God had intended it to do. I never knew about such a thing as near death experiences when the accident occurred, so sharing the event was not even given a thought. My family also noted that there was a change in me. On countless occasions, I was reminded that there was something different about me. I had changed and it seemed as though the Debra they knew did not exist anymore. All I know is that the Spirit that was living in Debra that came into the earth world was called back to God. In effect, Debra had died, and was never to return. I can remember each time I went to God, and leaving the spirit behind. It was though it was God's way of allowing that particular spirit to continue the rest of its existence on earth until it was his time to call it back to Him. I know there is a God. I know that spirits are only supposed to be in the flesh for a purpose. God let me know that. I am living proof. Home is where we go to God's home. I want to go back, for I know of the eternal Life, and Love, that is there. I have so many events that I have gone through since that time. These events remain unexplained as they are of God.
